rules: These are gate specifications, not executed tests.
Original 94 and repair 52 contracts remain immutable and mandatory as specified.
Related IDs are traceability links, never an assertion that one test proves all linked requirements.
Original minimum levels remain binding even if a grouping lists fewer general tiers.
Evidence comes from production-connected assertions; ios-build is not ios-runtime.
Live external AI evaluation can be unrun with explicit cause; its executable harness cannot be omitted.

gates.title: Takeover preserves interrupted work
gates.scenario: Inventory both worktrees and unpublished changes, create private backup hashes, start isolated recovery branches from chosen current bases.
gates.expected_observation: Original task and main branches unchanged; relevant unpublished repairs preserved; starting identities recorded.

gates.title: Strict comparator rejects wrong reference edges
gates.scenario: Call production shared comparator on a valid pair then swap producer, change scoped variable, or create dangling reference.
gates.expected_observation: All mutations rejected in both directions; a consistent bijective renaming passes.

gates.title: Strict comparator retains tree and text meaning
gates.scenario: Mutate nested key sets, native scalar types, optional presence, token kind, literal text, transform order and UTF-16 attachment range.
gates.expected_observation: No token shortcut equality or stringified scalar equality; paths and expected/actual mismatch reported.

gates.title: Evidence validator derives actual tiers
gates.scenario: Inject duplicate/missing IDs, changed contracts, false result, self-declared iOS labels, missing/stale artifacts, wrong SHA and zero matched tests into actual validator.
gates.expected_observation: Closure rejects each; ios-build never replaces ios-runtime; each case has one status; partial local report remains incomplete.

gates.title: Canonical action builder is really invoked
gates.scenario: Compile a real v2 call through the root adapter and a controlled canonical callback spy/mutation; include custom/full/append/static/descriptor cases.
gates.expected_observation: Actual canonical callback called with valid evaluated arguments; no second wire implementation in lowerer.

gates.title: Backend state and error isolation
gates.scenario: Alternate compile/decompile/catalog/analysis, inject emitter error and cancellation, repeat valid request; race-test exercised shared state.
gates.expected_observation: No state leaks, swallowed errors, process exit, lock deadlock or analysis side effect; required race configuration recorded.

gates.title: Direct reference transformations survive
gates.scenario: Construct action/system/variable references with ordered property, dictionary-key and coercion chains; emit/decode via real codec.
gates.expected_observation: Kinds, producers, all ordered transformations and native extensions preserved; removing any one fails strict comparison.

gates.title: Inline text references share canonical codec
gates.scenario: Emit repeated references after Hebrew, non-BMP emoji and combining marks; include raw/literal braces and inline transformed values.
gates.expected_observation: Exact rendered text and UTF-16 ranges; transforms survive both direct and inline paths; no old-text-parser interpretation.

gates.title: Semantic containers and native templates stay distinct
gates.scenario: Encode nested lists/maps with numbers, bools, empties and references, then native templates with similar-looking keys.
gates.expected_observation: Canonical typed container shapes, wrapper depth, item order and cardinality retained; no double encoding or flattening.

gates.title: Capture and written-order evaluation
gates.scenario: Run mutable and clipboard captures before later writes; use labelled arguments supplied out of schema order with observable evaluation effects.
gates.expected_observation: Each evaluated once in written order; saved values unchanged; no reevaluation during binding or encoding.

gates.title: Parameter forms and typed defaults
gates.scenario: Test omitted and explicit false/zero/empty/default values, literal-only, reference-only, numeric-text codecs, enum, named variadic list, extra positional args.
gates.expected_observation: Valid representations accepted by canonical backend; wrong forms diagnosed; no default/presence collapse or implicit argument shifting.

gates.title: Nested and mixed loop identity
gates.scenario: Nested outer A/B and inner 1/2; nested indices; mixed repeat/for; siblings; same-name scope tests; outer item used after inner loop.
gates.expected_observation: A:1,A:2,B:1,B:2 and independent expected zero-based index sequences; references resolve to distinct correct loop owners.

gates.title: Typed conditions and dynamic short circuit
gates.scenario: Use runtime-derived bools in all AND/OR cases with counted RHS side effect, dynamic equality/order checks and typed condition inputs.
gates.expected_observation: Exactly-once required evaluation and zero skipped RHS effects; case-sensitive equality as contracted; no generic addition fallback.

gates.title: Value blocks, loop results and return
gates.scenario: Value if/menu/loops with complete and incomplete yields, zero iterations, early return, bare return and unused final action results.
gates.expected_observation: One semantic value per normal iteration; proper branch/result references; return exits correct frame; main Void does not leak output.

gates.title: Function transport and recursion
gates.scenario: Nested and recursive calls with presence defaults, structured arguments/results, caller input and envelope-lookalike input; inject lowering failure.
gates.expected_observation: Shared canonical transport, correct caller continuation, preserved shapes/presence/input, complete error propagation, no accidental dispatch.

gates.title: Bounds and numeric semantics
gates.scenario: Test empty/first/last/negative/out-of-range static/dynamic indices; fractional division/modulus and compound assignments.
gates.expected_observation: Zero-based API preserved, no unsafe dynamic lookup or int64 truncation, numeric behavior follows approved contract.

gates.title: Metadata, setup and trigger preservation
gates.scenario: Roundtrip approved header fields, output/no-input metadata, seven approved trigger families, setup defaults and indices after helper insertion.
gates.expected_observation: All relevant fields preserve type/presence; questions target actual final action/parameter including zero; no automation-install claims.

gates.title: Native action/block/full workflow paths
gates.scenario: Import unknown nested/top-level keys, descriptors, variants, references, binary/date/large integer data across supported input formats.
gates.expected_observation: Exact tree and reference graph survive; full-native bypass actually works; typed readability retained for supported cases.

gates.title: Safe import editing and structural migration
gates.scenario: Migrate legacy metadata/references/includes, fail an unsupported conversion, then perform one authorized parameter edit on imported data.
gates.expected_observation: Originals survive failed conversion; intended delta only; no regex directive deletion; public output is v2, not legacy retry.

gates.title: Modules and existing standard functions
gates.scenario: Load alias-qualified local modules, cycles and duplicate aliases; reject runtime module init; migrate includes safely; runJS and chooseFromVCard explicitly tested.
gates.expected_observation: Real namespace and cycle handling; preserved stdfunc source feeds tested generated equivalents; no no-op imports.

gates.title: Authorized resource access and pure services
gates.scenario: Attempt symlink/traversal/out-of-root access, unresolved remote imports, network/process calls during analysis and invalid compile.
gates.expected_observation: Actual loader and public APIs reject unauthorized operations and never sign/execute/install during analysis.

gates.title: Live schema and generation failure handling
gates.scenario: Generate from real canonical definitions twice; break live export, facet assumption, codec binding, duplicate labels/enums.
gates.expected_observation: Deterministic valid output; each invalid condition fails; no automatic baseline snapshot fallback or fabricated evidence state.

gates.title: Real upstream declaration propagation
gates.scenario: Temporary actual actions/*.cherri edit; run exporter/generator/compiler/completion/docs pipeline and revert temp checkout.
gates.expected_observation: Changed parameter and its type reach every claimed consumer with unchanged real worktree; invalid facet assumption rejected.

gates.title: Real canonical behavior propagation
gates.scenario: Temporary static/custom callback/shared codec behavior edit; rebuild canonical oracle and v2 without editing v2 encoding.
gates.expected_observation: Both see same behavior; proves backend reuse beyond copying a new metadata label.

gates.title: One checked public CLI/mobile route
gates.scenario: Call actual entrypoints with email/Ask/directive-looking literals, v2 type errors and malformed functions; instrument legacy parser boundary.
gates.expected_observation: No substring misrouting, no old-parser retry, no output/signature after semantic failure; precise diagnostics and installed commands match docs.

gates.title: Exact explicit signing payload
gates.scenario: Compile A then B and sign with injected provider; stale globals/files and failed first signing; real sanitized HubSign/native flow after local tests.
gates.expected_observation: Request bytes equal intended artifact, correct name/path/error handling, no unsigned masquerade; real imported artifact belongs to current fixture.

gates.title: Real editor ranges, completion and stale edits
gates.scenario: Exercise actual Swift bridge/editor and LSP with incomplete code, UTF-16 text, multi-errors, parameter/enum replacement, rapid versioned edits, hover/rename/format.
gates.expected_observation: Correct contextual edits/ranges and only newest response applied; formatter preserves literals/comments; no independent Swift semantics.

gates.title: Preview bounded edit and measured performance
gates.scenario: Actual visual-to-source edit plus small/large/embedded-asset performance runs and cancellation/cache observation.
gates.expected_observation: Only intended source node changes; measured numbers and fixtures recorded; no claimed UI/performance from prose.

gates.title: Generated active docs and executable examples
gates.scenario: Generate signatures/snippets from schema; compile runnable guide/Skill examples; verify intended-error fixtures; inspect retrieval at pinned docs SHA.
gates.expected_observation: No drift, no old active syntax, no weakened examples; updated architecture and limitations reflect actual implementation.

gates.title: Complete extracted Skill and immutable compatibility
gates.scenario: Fresh/extracted/offline/cache-old-bundle/docs-mismatch/schema-mismatch/corrupt-download/update-rollback workflows through actual scripts.
gates.expected_observation: Exact compatible manifest identities; resolver selects validated binary; failed update preserves usable installation; no branch-only lock.

gates.title: Actual encoding negative gate and exact-SHA CI
gates.scenario: Intentionally violate required EXPECT in actual verifier, then run final real workflows and target computed assertions with artifact identity validation.
gates.expected_observation: Negative subprocess nonzero; positive final jobs successful at delivered revision; no skipped/cancelled/stale execution accepted.

gates.title: Full obligation accounting and executable AI harness
gates.scenario: Create complete requirement-to-test/evidence map for original 94+52, install/run fake-adapter evaluation harness and check external-provider configuration.
gates.expected_observation: No original requirement removed or relabelled; harness executable. Live external evaluation may be AI_EVAL_NOT_RUN only when endpoint unavailable.

gates.title: Approved frontend semantics remain enforced
gates.scenario: Verify all remaining original lexical/type/schema requirements against the immutable full product contract and map their exact additional native/runtime tiers. Reuse working tests without waiving stronger original levels.
gates.expected_observation: No new syntax design and no lost original obligations. Each required tier in the original contract is still independently mandatory.
